messages:
Ari (PM): Quick GA clearance needed for Nimbus. Core checklist: SLA, runbooks + smoke, oncall rota, dashboards, billing/quota. Propose hosted P99 <= 300ms for <=512 tokens, availability >= 99.9%. Canary + billing smoke required.

Micah (SRE): Clarify: SLA applies to default serving path (rwd-v1) only?

Ari (PM): Yes, default path only; other models are best-effort for GA and documented as such.

Jo (Eng): Canary is green on staging. I'll add a 15min prod canary and a tiny smoke step in runbook. Also adding rollback trigger: p99 > 400ms for 10m -> rollback.

Jo (Eng): Smoke snippet to include in runbook:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"healthcheck"}' | jq .status
```

Sana (FinOps): Billing items: need quota->rate-card mapping and an automated billing smoke (create org, run ~1k tokens, expect invoice webhook). I can run it if given test creds.

Micah (SRE): Proposed alerts:
- perf.p99 > 300ms for 5m -> Sev2
- error.rate > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 30m -> Exec page
I'll cover first 72h post-launch with Jo as secondary.

RunbookBot: Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/nimbus (canary checklist included).

Ari (PM): Owners for signoff doc: Ari -> SLA + exec ping; Micah -> alerts + oncall rota; Jo -> canary + runbook + rollback; Sana -> billing mapping + smoke. Please :thumbsup: to accept. No objections by 18:00 PT -> proceed with launch window tomorrow.

Jo (Eng): :thumbsup:

Micah (SRE): :thumbsup:

Sana (FinOps): :thumbsup: will post billing test results here.

Ari (PM): Thanks all  assembling signoff now and will ping execs after the smoke results.
